title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START! — Episode4 Last Resort

meta.Event Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the big agencies and even the small ones are out...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't think about how an agency would come under fire just because they hired us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This means no one is gonna want to work with us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know we were prepared for this, but that doesn't make it any easier to accept.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this isn't the kind of problem we can solve with positive thinking alone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, come on, you guys.
Don't get so down!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're supposed to give our fans hope, right? We can't give up now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right... We need to figure out our next step.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Indeed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping it wasn't true, but we might have to consider what could happen if our old agencies really did put pressure on whoever we end up working for...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's a possibility we could end up destroying the hopes of other idols in the process...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can't do that...! I would never forgive myself if I was the reason another idol lost the ability to smile!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe we just aren't meant to be on stage after all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's not true...!
There has to be something we can do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to keep trying! I'm not ready to give up looking for a path to becoming idols!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
Sorry. I'm just upset.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry too...!
I still have to try even more!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we're all a little exhausted right now. Perhaps it would be best to call it a day and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I think you're right. Maybe we'll think of something once we've had the chance to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try to think of something too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, just get some rest, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you really can't sit still, use your energy to practice dancing or singing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Be careful on your way home, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will do! See ya!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No way I'm giving up now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need to do everything in my power to make this work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello? Yes, this is...
The next day
CEO's Office

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Momoi. It's been a while...
The last time we spoke was when you quit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me, sir. I was hoping to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Ah, I believe I've heard.
You're trying to form a new group, correct?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I already gave up on being an idol once, but a lot has happened with the girls in my group and we've finally come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The four of us want to be idols together.
We want to get back up on that stage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, please!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I'm in no position to ask you this after transferring to another agency and then quitting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you won't ever hear another complaint from me. Variety programs, talent work... I'll do anything your agency needs me to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Please! All I ask is that you let us the four of us join together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will you consider us?!

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I see. Your friends must be very precious to you if you're willing to go that far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, they are...!

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: However, I have no way to say for sure that hiring Ms. Kiritani and Ms. Hinomori won't have a negative effect on the other girls' job offers.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: If it were just you, I would actually consider it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I understand. I apologize for asking something as unreasonable as this.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I see. That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd be a little more pragmatic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for your time...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
That was my last connection.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great...!
Now I'm letting it get to me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the four of us decided to spread hope together! We have to keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...
